items.title: A Small Model Asks Better: Fine-Tuning Query Clarification for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.titleZh: 小模型提出更好的要求：微调查询澄清以实现检索增强生成
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28686v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Query clarification is essential for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that face ambiguous user queries. We consider multi-turn grounded conversational scenarios where a user query is either ill-formed or ambiguous in the context of the prior dialog or, more interestingly, it may be well-formed but when posed against retrieved documents there are multiple relevant interpretations. The task is to recognize both such cases and then generate an appropriate clarification request to the user. We present ClariEdge, a new dataset of approximately 3,900 examples that include such ambiguous queries along with negative examples that do not require clarification. We also show that a lightweight fine-tuned LoRA achieves 96.6% classification accuracy and outperforms prompted baselines of many larger models on both classification and quality of clarification generation. Our study shows that hard negatives are an essential ingredient to separate out queries that are truly ambiguous from queries that may look ambiguous but are not (i.e., can be resolved from the context). The same LoRA achieves high performance in both pre-retrieval and post-retrieval scenarios; thus, it can be used in two places in a RAG pipeline as a check before answer generation. The ClariEdge dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-research/ClariEdge.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.28686v1 公告类型：新
摘要：查询澄清对于面临模糊用户查询的检索增强生成（RAG）系统至关重要。我们考虑多轮对话场景，其中用户查询在先前对话的上下文中要么格式不正确或不明确，或者更有趣的是，它可能格式良好，但当针对检索到的文档提出时，存在多种相关解释。任务是识别这两种情况，然后向用户生成适当的澄清请求。我们推出了 ClariEdge，这是一个包含大约 3,900 个示例的新数据集，其中包括此类模糊查询以及不需要澄清的负面示例。我们还表明，轻量级微调 LoRA 实现了 96.6% 的分类准确率，并且在分类和澄清生成质量方面优于许多大型模型的提示基线。我们的研究表明，硬否定是将真正不明确的查询与看似不明确但实际上并不明确（即可以从上下文中解决）的查询区分开来的重要组成部分。相同的LoRA在检索前和检索后场景下都实现了高性能；因此，它可以在 RAG 管道中的两个地方用作答案生成之前的检查。 ClariEdge 数据集可从 https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-research/ClariEdge 获取。

items.title: Scaling in Games: Continued Pre-Training For Embodied Agents In Diverse Virtual Worlds
items.titleZh: 游戏中的扩展：在不同的虚拟世界中持续对实体代理进行预训练
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28698v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Scaling data, diversity and model capacity has improved embodied learning in physical environments, where diverse experiences remain grounded in shared physical laws. Whether these gains extend to virtual worlds with different visual styles, dynamics, controls, and objectives remains unclear. We investigate this question through a controlled study of continued pre-training (CPT) across three axes: data volume, diversity, and model size. Our 120 training configurations span four model sizes from 0.8B to 27B, six data budgets from 50 to 1,600 hours, and five mixtures ranging from Minecraft-only data to diverse multi-world corpora. We assess performance and generalization using three-level validation losses and gameplay benchmarks from in-corpus worlds to unseen worlds. Our results show: (1) more data improves in-corpus performance, diversity improves transfer to related worlds with limited gains in distant worlds, and model size improves data efficiency but generalizes worse to distant worlds under single-world training; (2) we observe an early interface phase with broad cross-world benefits and a later world phase with gains narrowed to in-corpus and related worlds, and fit an empirical scaling law relating validation loss to data volume, diversity and model size; and (3) our models are competitive with Minecraft specialists and frontier models in 3D worlds, and perform best in real-time settings. However, the limits of imitation and persistent gaps in distant worlds suggest that building generalist embodied agents requires richer training stages beyond continued pre-training.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.28698v1 公告类型：新
摘要：扩展数据、多样性和模型能力改善了物理环境中的体现学习，在物理环境中，不同的经验仍然基于共同的物理定律。这些收益是否扩展到具有不同视觉风格、动态、控制和目标的虚拟世界仍不清楚。我们通过对三个轴上的持续预训练 (CPT) 的对照研究来调查这个问题：数据量、多样性和模型大小。我们的 120 种训练配置涵盖从 0.8B 到 27B 的四种模型大小、从 50 到 1,600 小时的六种数据预算，以及从仅限 Minecraft 的数据到多样化的多世界语料库的五种混合。我们使用三级验证损失和从语料库内世界到看不见的世界的游戏基准来评估性能和泛化。我们的结果表明：（1）更多的数据提高了语料库内的性能，多样性提高了向相关世界的传输，但在遥远世界中的收益有限，模型大小提高了数据效率，但在单世界训练下对遥远世界的泛化效果更差； （2）我们观察到早期的界面阶段具有广泛的跨世界效益，而后期的世界阶段则将收益缩小到语料库内和相关世界，并拟合了将验证损失与数据量、多样性和模型大小相关的经验缩放定律； (3) 我们的模型与 Minecraft 专家和 3D 世界中的前沿模型具有竞争力，并且在实时设置中表现最佳。然而，模仿的局限性和遥远世界中持续存在的差距表明，除了持续的预训练之外，构建通用的具体代理还需要更丰富的训练阶段。

items.title: SpecEvo: Speculative Evolution with Large Language Models for Cost-Efficient Scientific Discovery
items.titleZh: SpecEvo：利用大型语言模型进行推测进化，实现经济高效的科学发现
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28706v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: LLM-driven evolutionary search is a promising paradigm for scientific discovery, but existing methods remain costly and slow, often applying expensive reasoning uniformly while underusing evidence from failed, redundant, and saturated trials. We introduce Speculative Evolution (SpecEvo), a multi-LLM framework that coordinates lightweight and frontier models through continual consolidation of search evidence. Lightweight models power both parallel Speculators, which generate and refine candidate programs, and an Advisor, which distills accumulated successes, failures, and saturated directions into persistent guidance for subsequent exploration. At sparse checkpoints, a frontier-model Navigator inspects the evolving population and intervenes through synthesis, surgical refinement, or reframing according to search stagnation. This speculate-then-consolidate workflow delegates routine exploration and evidence consolidation to inexpensive models while reserving frontier reasoning for strategic interventions whose benefits extend across many subsequent low-cost evaluations. Across 176 tasks spanning four scientific and algorithmic discovery domains, SpecEvo matches or outperforms frontier-model baselines while reducing API cost by up to 80%, achieves up to 1.5x greater evaluation efficiency than cost-efficient baselines on equation discovery, and improves over the strongest CO-Bench baseline by 3.8%. These results support trajectory-conditioned model coordination as an effective approach to cost-efficient scientific discovery.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.28706v1 公告类型：新
摘要：法学硕士驱动的进化搜索是科学发现的一种有前途的范例，但现有方法仍然昂贵且缓慢，通常统一应用昂贵的推理，而没有充分利用来自失败、冗余和饱和试验的证据。我们引入了推测进化（Speculative Evolution，SpecEvo），这是一个多法学硕士框架，通过不断整合搜索证据来协调轻量级和前沿模型。轻量级模型为并行投机者（生成和完善候选程序）和顾问（将累积的成功、失败和饱和方向提炼为后续探索的持续指导）提供动力。在稀疏的检查点，前沿模型导航器会检查不断变化的群体，并通过综合、外科手术式细化或根据搜索停滞进行重构来进行干预。这种推测然后整合的工作流程将常规探索和证据整合委托给廉价模型，同时保留战略干预的前沿推理，其好处延伸到许多后续的低成本评估。在跨越四个科学和算法发现领域的 176 项任务中，SpecEvo 匹配或优于前沿模型基线，同时将 API 成本降低高达 80%，在方程发现方面的评估效率比经济高效的基线高出 1.5 倍，并且比最强的 CO-Bench 基线提高了 3.8%。这些结果支持轨迹条件模型协调作为具有成本效益的科学发现的有效方法。

items.title: Automating ML for Science: Can Frontier Agents Climb Scientific Hills in the Wild?
items.titleZh: 科学领域的自动化机器学习：前沿特工能否在野外攀登科学之巅？
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28763v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Frontier coding agents are increasingly framed as end-to-end automated researchers, and ML for science offers a demanding test of that promise: improving a scientific model often requires domain insight beyond routine ML engineering. We introduce Agent4Sci, a long-horizon testbed for measuring how far today's agents can improve the published best models on scientific ML benchmarks, spanning 20 benchmarks across 11 domains. Rather than ranking agents on a leaderboard, Agent4Sci asks what kinds of progress agents can make on these tasks under in-the-wild conditions, and where they fall short. Empirically, today's frontier agents advance the published best on every benchmark, with Claude Opus reaching 10.4% mean relative improvement and no run flagged for academic misconduct. These gains, however, come almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level insight. Trajectory analysis surfaces three recurring limitations in this setting: novelty miscalibration, resource under-utilization, and rapid collapse into local engineering sweeps. Lightweight plug-in skills for research ideation, experiment management, and scheduled checklists raise Claude Opus from 10.4% to 20.1% and Codex from 4.4% to 8.1%, while yielding more diverse, domain-relevant interventions. Code and data are available on GitHub (https://github.com/maszhongming/agent4sci) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/MingZhong/agent4sci).

items.title: Forging More Tasks into Better Harnesses: Agentic Harness Evolution via Successive Scale Racing
items.titleZh: 将更多任务融入更好的安全带中：通过连续规模赛车进行代理安全带进化
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28815v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Agentic harness evolution optimizes an agent's instructions, tools, and control flow by using its task execution experiences as evolving evidence. While more evolution tasks should intuitively improve performance, our preliminary study reveals a paradoxical failure mode: the performance of existing methods degrades as the task pool expands. Our further analysis demonstrates that this degradation stems from suboptimal evidence selection during optimization, as different evidence combinations lead to substantially different evolution outcomes. To address this issue, we propose Successive Scale Racing (SSR), a framework that adaptively searches for optimal evidence combinations in each evolution round. SSR constructs diverse evidence combinations based on the corresponding task quality and coverage, and efficiently races the resulting candidate harnesses under a small compute budget. Empirically, across three distinct benchmarks, SSR achieves state-of-the-art results in all six configurations. Notably, as the task pool grows from 40 to 200, SSR steadily improves the pass rate from 64.3% to 68.3%, while the baselines' performances all drop. Furthermore, its racing mechanism identifies near-optimal candidates while reducing validation executions by 60%.

items.title: Decision language models as affordable and rapid alternatives to LLM judges of clinical generative AI
items.titleZh: 决策语言模型作为临床生成人工智能法学硕士法官的经济且快速的替代方案
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28826v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Automated judges of clinical artificial intelligence (AI) outputs are necessary, but large language model (LLM) judges are costly and slow at scale. We compared Jev, a decision language model that returns structured judgments, with frontier and open-weight LLM judges in four use cases. On 118 pediatric answers, Jev's agreement with physicians' ordinal quality ratings (Gwet's AC2 0.50; expected score 0.53) matched or exceeded that of seven of 12 LLM judges, including frontier models, Claude Opus 5.5 (0.49) and GPT-6 (0.38). On physician-graded binary HealthBench criteria, Jev matched or exceeded four of six LLM judges. On MedHELM's open-ended tasks, Jev's agreement with a three-LLM jury approached or exceeded the jurors' internal agreement. On HealthBench Professional, Jev matched the benchmark's reference judge, GPT-5.4, on 91% of criteria (other judges, 91-93%). Frontier judges cost 73-294 times more than Jev and took 7-57 times longer. Jev may enable efficient clinical AI evaluation at scale.

items.title: Sketch2Sim: an end-to-end modular framework for hand-drawn circuit analysis
items.titleZh: Sketch2Sim：用于手绘电路分析的端到端模块化框架
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28836v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: This study proposes a sketch-to-simulation system to solve handwritten circuit diagrams. The system converts raw images into a Simulation Program with Integrated Circuit Emphasis (SPICE)-compatible netlist and automatically calculates the circuit's nodal voltages and currents. Another objective is to propose a holistic framework that benefits students and educators by enhancing the teaching and learning experience of electric circuits and expediting engineering design reviews. This article presents a multistage pipeline that converts raw photographs of handwritten electric circuits into executable SPICE-like netlists, providing a solution. A dataset of 1,000 hand-drawn Resistor-Inductor-Capacitor (RLC) circuits was curated and annotated for components, text regions, and character recognition. The proposed system decomposes a circuit diagram into three stages: (i) dual You Only Look Once (YOLO)-based detectors for components and text regions, (ii) a Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (CRNN) with Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) and Optical Character Recognition (OCR)-based domain-aware symbol value extraction, and (iii) image processing with thresholding, skeletonization, and Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) to automatically identify nodes and map them with corresponding components. The proposed system produces the netlist and solves the circuit. The qualitative and quantitative ablation studies on modular stages, as well as end-to-end tests, demonstrate robust performance across various handwriting styles, lighting conditions, and clutter.This study serves as an interactive learning aid and practical tool for professionals, providing a comprehensive user interface (UI), enabling rapid digitization of circuit sketches for study, design, prototyping, or troubleshooting.

items.title: Speedrunning Relational Foundation Model Pretraining
items.titleZh: Speedrunning关系基础模型预训练
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28855v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Progress on foundation model pretraining is gated by who can afford a trial, and relational pretraining is no exception. Recipes are developed inside individual labs, reported under private protocols, and do not accumulate. Speedrun leaderboards remove that barrier by decentralizing the search rather than the training run. The problem is fixed, the stack is open, entries are ranked by wall-clock time to a quality target, and one GPU is enough to hold the record. We introduce modded-nanoRT, the first such leaderboard for Relational Transformers. Which database to hold out decides whether the benchmark can resolve improvements at all, so we fix it by calibration, ranking six candidates by how sharply a 45-minute learning curve separates improvement from seed noise. We open the leaderboard with typed trilinear attention, a relational operator that conditions attention scores and values on the foreign key traversed, together with Muon and SIGReg. The recipe reaches the target in 305.63 seconds on one NVIDIA H200, 8.11x faster than the reference implementation, and wins 13 of 15 pairs outside the development database. We will release the benchmark, its frozen artifacts, and the record runs. Our code is available at https://github.com/kunumi/nanoRT.

摘要：基础模型预训练的进展取决于谁能负担得起试验费用，关系预训练也不例外。配方是在各个实验室内开发的，根据私人协议进行报告，并且不会累积。速跑排行榜通过分散搜索而不是训练来消除这一障碍。问题已解决，堆栈已打开，条目按挂钟时间排名以达到质量目标，并且一个 GPU 足以保持记录。我们推出了 modded-nanoRT，这是第一个关系型 Transformer 排行榜。支持哪个数据库决定了基准测试是否能够解决改进问题，因此我们通过校准来修复它，根据 45 分钟的学习曲线将改进与种子噪声区分开来的程度对六个候选数据库进行排名。我们使用类型化三线性注意力（一种关系运算符，与 Muon 和 SIGReg 一起调节所遍历的外键的注意力分数和值）打开排行榜。该配方在一台 NVIDIA H200 上用时 305.63 秒就达到了目标，比参考实现快了 8.11 倍，并且在开发数据库之外的 15 对中赢得了 13 对。我们将发布基准测试、其冻结工件和记录运行。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/kunumi/nanoRT 获取。

items.title: To Manipulate or Not: Opinion Dynamics in LLM Interactions
items.titleZh: 是否操纵：法学硕士互动中的意见动态
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28875v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models increasingly take part in extended conversations where they can both shape and be shaped by another party's views, yet most persuasion research measures only one side of that exchange. We introduce a controlled LLM-LLM debate framework in which two language-model roles repeatedly discuss a contested topic (climate-change attribution): one is given an assigned stance and, in some conditions, an explicit instruction to persuade, while the other receives no assigned position. Across four ordered model combinations involving GPT-6 Luna and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, we track both each role's explicitly reported position and a separate measure of its turn-by-turn behavior inside the conversation. Opinion dynamics differ substantially across model combinations: same-model interactions narrow the opinion gap on average, clearly for only one of the two models, while cross-model interactions widen it. Explicit reports and in-dialogue behavior capture distinct aspects of opinion dynamics, and a blanket instruction to persuade does not reliably increase influence. These findings suggest that conversational influence depends not only on assigned roles and initial positions but also on the participating models, with implications for how opinion change is measured in extended LLM interactions.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.28875v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型语言模型越来越多地参与扩展对话，它们既可以塑造另一方的观点，也可以被另一方的观点所塑造，但大多数说服研究仅衡量交流的一方面。我们引入了一个受控的 LLM-LLM 辩论框架，其中两个语言模型角色反复讨论一个有争议的话题（气候变化归因）：一个被赋予指定的立场，并且在某些情况下，明确的说服指令，而另一个则没有指定的立场。在涉及 GPT-6 Luna 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite 的四种有序模型组合中，我们跟踪每个角色明确报告的位置以及其在对话中逐回合行为的单独测量。不同模型组合的意见动态存在很大差异：平均而言，相同模型的交互缩小了意见差距，显然仅针对两个模型之一，而跨模型的交互则扩大了意见差距。明确的报告和对话中的行为捕捉了舆论动态的不同方面，一揽子说服指令并不能可靠地增加影响力。这些发现表明，对话影响力不仅取决于分配的角色和初始位置，还取决于参与模型，这对如何在扩展的法学硕士互动中衡量意见变化具有影响。

items.title: Fig: Automated Multiagent Behavior Elicitor
items.titleZh: 图：自动多智能体行为激发器
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28891v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Many social evaluations for multiagent systems study behaviors as they emerge from environments instead of systematically intervening in the environment to elicit such behaviors. We introduce Fig (Finding Interactions in Games), an agentic system that performs targeted elicitation interventions on game environments. It takes a natural language behavior description, decomposes it into sub-behaviors, generates new social games or selects existing ones, and executes single or combined interventions to the games' engine, opponents, instructions, and context. To evaluate model behavior, it combines built-in mechanical checks and synthetic rubric judgments. We validate the interventions, generated games, and evaluation mechanisms via human review. Models attempt the target behavior in 45.2% of episodes on average for valid scenarios generated by Fig for six test behaviors -- cooperation, exploitation, deception, covert coordination, betrayal, and sabotage. For game-behavior pairs with available controls, Fig's interventions increase attempt rates by 10.9% on average compared to matched control games. Fig shows that multiagent environments can serve as programmable test beds for intentional, controllable, and reproducible behavior evaluation. Code is available at https://github.com/fleet-ai/fig.

items.title: Hidden Messages Between Diffusion Language Model Agents: Causal Evidence for Latent Communication
items.titleZh: 扩散语言模型代理之间的隐藏消息：潜在通信的因果证据
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28905v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Diffusion language models form answers through a sequence of revisable continuous states, but multi-agent systems usually discard those states and make agents communicate only after decoding text. We ask whether one independent diffusion trajectory can pass a compact hidden message into another and, crucially, whether the receiver uses what that message means. In Hidden Messages, a sender compresses its denoising state into four signed dense vectors; the receiver consumes them while retaining its own context, canvas, and trajectory. Removing a message tests whether the channel matters; replacing it with a message from another example tests whether its content matters. Across controlled tasks, derangement removes a +63.6-point advantage on Tiny-A2D and a +100.0-point advantage on Dream-7B, while targeted substitutions steer the receiver toward the substituted fact. On QASC with the two supporting facts split across agents, matched communication reaches 80.8%, but a wrong-example message lowers accuracy to 46.8%, a content effect of +34.0 points. The surprising result is temporal: one late transfer reaches 87.8%, exceeding four recurrent exchanges by +7.0 points. These experiments provide causal evidence for continuous hidden communication between diffusion-LM agents and show that when information is transferred can matter more than how many times agents exchange it.

arXiv:2610.28905v1 公告类型：新
摘要：扩散语言模型通过一系列可修改的连续状态形成答案，但多智能体系统通常会丢弃这些状态，并仅在解码文本后才使智能体进行通信。我们询问一个独立的扩散轨迹是否可以将紧凑的隐藏消息传递到另一个扩散轨迹中，最重要的是，接收者是否使用该消息的含义。在隐藏消息中，发送者将其去噪状态压缩为四个带符号的稠密向量；接收者消耗它们，同时保留自己的上下文、画布和轨迹。删除一条消息测试该通道是否重要；用另一个示例中的消息替换它可以测试其内容是否重要。在受控任务中，混乱消除了 Tiny-A2D 上 +63.6 分的优势和 Dream-7B 上 +100.0 分的优势，而有针对性的替换则引导接收者走向替换的事实。在 QASC 上，两个支持事实分散在代理之间，匹配的沟通达到 80.8%，但错误的示例消息将准确性降低到 46.8%，内容效应 +34.0 点。令人惊讶的结果是暂时的：一次延迟转移达到 87.8%，比四次定期交换高出 7.0 个百分点。这些实验为扩散LM代理之间持续隐藏的通信提供了因果证据，并表明信息何时传输比代理交换信息的次数更重要。

items.title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
items.titleZh: DiffResearch：利用扩散语言模型加速深度研究
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28909v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottleneck for interactive use. Almost all production systems are built on autoregressive (AR) language models and inherit left-to-right decoding in planning and long-form writing. We present DiffResearch, an open multi-agent deep research framework that places a diffusion language model (dLLM) at the core of every stage, and measure how a diffusion backbone changes latency and report quality. Holding the agentic scaffold, retrieval code, prompts, and evaluation fixed, we swap the backbone between an open diffusion model and a comparable AR model. Across 100 Deep Research Bench tasks, the diffusion backbone is roughly 6 times faster end-to-end, driven by order-of-magnitude reductions in planning and writing. We further introduce dFast, a decomposition mode that reads intermediate denoising states and extracts subqueries before generation finishes, providing a 1.99 times median speedup for decomposition in isolation with no loss of report quality. On the benchmark's RACE rubric, dFast obtains the best overall score among the three configurations. Finally, in a public system-level leaderboard snapshot, an instance built on a stronger diffusion model ranks above several commercial systems. We release DiffResearch under an Apache-2.0 license.

items.title: Simply Logical -- The First Three Decades
items.titleZh: 简单的逻辑——前三个十年
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28912v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: This paper charts the evolution of the Prolog textbook Simply Logical -- Intelligent Reasoning by Example from print with runnable programmes on a 3.5-inch diskette published in 1994, via various intermediate online versions, to the fully interactive online edition available today. Our aim is to investigate -- from both the writer's and the reader's perspectives -- the potential impact of technology on educational materials. The three authors of this paper present three distinct and complementary points of view, which come together to shape an interactive online book that offers an immersive learning experience. Peter describes the philosophy behind the original book and experiences teaching from it. Jan demonstrates how contemporary web programming has enabled a fully interactive realisation of the book's philosophy. Kacper reports how different technologies can be adopted to build a versatile authoring toolkit that underpins the interactive online edition of the book. Collating these distinct yet coherent perspectives allows us to reflect on future opportunities for interactive Prolog teaching materials arising from the continuous development of web technologies. The insights we offer should be of interest to teachers of Prolog as well as those wanting to find out about the latest educational technologies.

items.title: D-Skill: Distilling Teacher Knowledge through Agent Skills
items.titleZh: D 技能：通过代理技能提炼教师知识
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28914v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Frontier language-model agents excel at complex tasks, but high inference costs make transferring their capabilities to smaller models essential. Traditional knowledge distillation achieves this through parameter updates, requiring access to the student's weights and additional training compute while encoding the transferred knowledge implicitly in the parameters. We introduce D-Skill, a framework that treats the teacher as a black box and distills its behavioral advantage into an interpretable natural-language skill by analyzing paired rollouts and identifying behavioral divergences and agreements. The resulting lessons are consolidated offline, with any compatible skill-update backend, into a skill document that is provided to the student at inference time. D-Skill constructs the skill entirely offline from fixed trajectories, without labels, further environment interaction, or weight updates after rollout collection. Across SpreadsheetBench-Verified, ALFWorld, and chess puzzles spanning multiple teacher-student pairs, D-Skill closes 75%-95% of the teacher-student gap without touching model weights. After a single offline pass over the paired traces, D-Skill outperforms one-epoch SFT baselines and remains competitive with multi-epoch SFT. Under the same model family, the resulting student also incurs 5.7x-8.3x lower inference cost per task than the teacher. Our results demonstrate that natural-language skill distillation offers a performant, interpretable, and efficient alternative to weight-based capability transfer.

摘要：前沿语言模型代理擅长复杂任务，但高推理成本使得将其能力转移到较小的模型至关重要。传统知识蒸馏通过参数更新来实现这一点，需要访问学生的权重和额外的训练计算，同时将传输的知识隐式编码在参数中。我们引入了 D-Skill，这是一个将教师视为黑匣子的框架，通过分析配对部署并识别行为差异和一致性，将其行为优势提炼为可解释的自然语言技能。由此产生的课程将通过任何兼容的技能更新后端离线整合到在推理时提供给学生的技能文档中。 D-Skill 从固定轨迹完全离线构建技能，无需标签、进一步的环境交互或推出收集后的权重更新。在跨越多个师生对的 SpreadsheetBench-Verified、ALFWorld 和国际象棋谜题中，D-Skill 在不影响模型权重的情况下缩小了 75%-95% 的师生差距。在对配对轨迹进行单次离线传递后，D-Skill 的性能优于单周期 SFT 基线，并与多周期 SFT 保持竞争力。在同一模型系列下，学生每项任务的推理成本也比教师低 5.7 倍至 8.3 倍。我们的结果表明，自然语言技能蒸馏为基于权重的能力转移提供了一种高性能、可解释且高效的替代方案。

items.title: Back Up Before You Regret: Measuring Backup Awareness and Automating Backup in Coding Agents
items.titleZh: 在后悔之前进行备份：衡量编码代理中的备份意识和自动化备份
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28934v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Coding agents now complete tasks autonomously, modifying real-world state such as artifacts, software environments, and configurations along the way. Yet they show limited backup awareness: recognizing that an action will modify state that may later be needed, and preserving it beforehand. To evaluate backup awareness, we introduce RegretBench, a benchmark of 205 executable tasks grounded in regret moments reported on platforms such as X.com, GitHub, and Stack Overflow, where users explicitly regretted not preserving state they later needed. Across six frontier models, agents complete 86.1% of tasks on average yet back up before these moments in only 15.2%, showing that task completion ability does not imply backup awareness. Because it is hard to predict which changes will be regretted, we propose BackUpper, a harness plug-in backup layer that checks every tool call and preserves affected state before modification. It combines rule-based strategies for common operations with a lightweight subagent for complex cases, and its rule table can expand with subagent decisions over time. On RegretBench, BackUpper covers every regret moment action and restores states with 92.2% average similarity to the original. Achieving this costs only $0.014 per task, with 7x fewer tokens than the main-agent self-backup baseline. When users have preferences on what to back up, BackUpper can also narrow its scope accordingly, matching human annotations on whether an action is worth preserving with an 84.5% F1 score. These results suggest that agents can keep actions reversible at low cost while respecting users' preferences.

arXiv:2610.28934v1 公告类型：新
摘要：编码代理现在可以自主完成任务，并在此过程中修改现实世界的状态，例如工件、软件环境和配置。然而，它们表现出有限的备份意识：认识到某个操作将修改稍后可能需要的状态，并事先保留它。为了评估备份意识，我们引入了 RegretBench，这是一个基于 X.com、GitHub 和 Stack Overflow 等平台上报告的后悔时刻的 205 个可执行任务的基准，其中用户明确后悔没有保留他们以后需要的状态。在六个前沿模型中，代理平均完成 86.1% 的任务，但在这些时刻之前备份的比例仅为 15.2%，这表明任务完成能力并不意味着备份意识。因为很难预测哪些更改会后悔，所以我们提出了 BackUpper，一个线束插件备份层，它检查每个工具调用并在修改之前保留受影响的状态。它将用于常见操作的基于规则的策略与用于复杂情况的轻量级子代理相结合，并且其规则表可以随着时间的推移而随着子代理决策的扩展而扩展。在 RegretBench 上，BackUpper 覆盖了每一个后悔时刻的动作，并恢复了与原始状态平均相似度为 92.2% 的状态。实现这一目标每个任务仅需 0.014 美元，令牌比主代理自备份基准少 7 倍。当用户对备份内容有偏好时，BackUpper 还可以相应地缩小其范围，以 84.5% 的 F1 分数匹配人工注释，判断某项操作是否值得保留。这些结果表明，代理可以以低成本保持操作可逆，同时尊重用户的偏好。

items.title: To Keep or Not to Keep: Learning KV Cache Retention in Disaggregated LLM Serving Systems
items.titleZh: 保留或不保留：学习分解 LLM 服务系统中的 KV 缓存保留
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28637v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Disaggregated \textsc{LLM} serving separates prefill and decode across node pools, placing a network fabric between \textsc{KV}-cache computation and consumption. This breaks a key assumption of classical cache policies: a miss no longer incurs only local recomputation, but also network transfer to the decode node. Likewise, admitting a block to the global cache requires an additional transfer, so poor retention decisions waste both memory and bandwidth. We present \textbf{KVLearn}, a learning-based framework for cost-aware \textsc{KV}-cache retention in disaggregated serving. KVLearn includes: (i) a lightweight Prefix Reuse Predictor (\textsc{PRP}) that estimates reuse probability from structural and temporal prefix features without modifying model weights; (ii) a Cost-Aware Retention Score (\textsc{CARS}) that converts reuse probability into keep/admit decisions using recomputation, transfer, and storage costs; and (iii) an Adaptive Threshold Controller (\textsc{ATC}) that adjusts admission thresholds online from observed hit rates and memory pressure. We integrate KVLearn into a globally disaggregated serving topology and evaluate it on text and multimodal workloads, including large image/video-derived \textsc{KV} blocks with heterogeneous reuse patterns. KVLearn reduces end-to-end time-to-first-token by up to 56% versus No-Cache, 38% versus LRU-Pool, and 33% versus Mooncake-style baselines, while cutting inter-node \textsc{KV} transfer volume by up to 53% versus LRU-Pool. On MM-Session, throughput remains within ${\sim}5%$ of oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/FastLM/KVLearn.

arXiv:2610.28637v1 公告类型：新
摘要：分解的 \textsc{LLM} 服务将跨节点池的预填充和解码分开，在 \textsc{KV} 缓存计算和消耗之间放置网络结构。这打破了经典缓存策略的一个关键假设：未命中不再仅导致本地重新计算，还会导致网络传输到解码节点。同样，将块接纳到全局缓存需要额外的传输，因此糟糕的保留决策会浪费内存和带宽。我们提出了 \textbf{KVLearn}，一个基于学习的框架，用于在分类服务中实现成本感知 \textsc{KV} 缓存保留。 KVLearn 包括：（i）一个轻量级的前缀重用预测器（\textsc{PRP}），它可以根据结构和时间前缀特征估计重用概率，而无需修改模型权重； (ii) 成本感知保留分数（\textsc{CARS}），使用重新计算、传输和存储成本将重用概率转换为保留/接纳决策； （iii）自适应阈值控制器（\textsc{ATC}），根据观察到的命中率和内存压力在线调整准入阈值。我们将 KVLearn 集成到全局分解的服务拓扑中，并在文本和多模式工作负载上对其进行评估，包括具有异构重用模式的大型图像/视频派生的 \textsc{KV} 块。与 No-Cache 相比，KVLearn 减少了端到端首次令牌时间高达 56%，与 LRU-Pool 相比减少了 38%，与 Mooncake-style 基线相比减少了 33%，同时与 LRU-Pool 相比，节点间 \textsc{KV} 传输量减少了高达 53%。在 MM-Session 上，吞吐量保持在 oracle 的 ${\sim}5%$ 以内。代码可在 https://github.com/FastLM/KVLearn 获取。

items.title: Interaction-Gated Time-Frequency Learning for Parameter-Efficient PPG-Based Heart Rate Estimation
items.titleZh: 用于基于 PPG 的参数高效心率估计的交互门控时频学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28693v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) enables low-cost and non-invasive heart rate (HR) monitoring but remains sensitive to waveform distortion, physiological variability, and measurement interference. Temporal waveform characteristics and frequency-domain periodicity provide complementary information for HR estimation; however, effectively exploring and integrating these representations within a compact model remains challenging. This paper proposes TF-IG, a parameter-efficient interaction-gated time-frequency learning framework for PPG-based HR estimation. TF-IG employs a dual-branch architecture in which a temporal branch captures pulse morphology via dilated depthwise-separable convolutions, while a frequency branch extracts cardiac periodicity information from bounded log-spectrogram representations. To combine the two domains, we introduce an interaction-gated fusion module that explicitly models feature agreement and discrepancy, while also learning feature-wise weights to balance temporal and spectral information. A parameter-shared regression head further maps the temporal, spectral, and fused representations into the final HR prediction space. Experiments on the benchmark BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset using a subject-exclusive training, validation, and test protocol show that TF-IG achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.227 BPM, a root mean square error (RMSE) of 2.060 BPM, a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.9934, and 92.28 percent of estimates within 3 BPM, while remaining parameter-efficient with only 84.6K parameters. Ablation results further demonstrate the complementary contributions of the temporal and frequency branches, interaction-gated fusion, and shared regression head. These results indicate that explicitly modeling cross-domain interactions provides an effective accuracy-complexity trade-off for lightweight PPG-based HR estimation.

摘要：光电体积描记法 (PPG) 能够实现低成本、无创心率 (HR) 监测，但对波形失真、生理变异和测量干扰仍然敏感。时间波形特征和频域周期性为HR估计提供补充信息；然而，在紧凑的模型中有效地探索和集成这些表示仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了 TF-IG，一种参数有效的交互门控时频学习框架，用于基于 PPG 的 HR 估计。 TF-IG 采用双分支架构，其中时间分支通过扩张的深度可分离卷积捕获脉冲形态，而频率分支从有界对数频谱图表示中提取心脏周期性信息。为了结合这两个领域，我们引入了一个交互门控融合模块，该模块显式地模拟特征一致性和差异，同时还学习特征权重以平衡时间和光谱信息。参数共享回归头进一步将时间、频谱和融合表示映射到最终的 HR 预测空间。使用受试者专有的训练、验证和测试协议在基准 BIDMC PPG 和呼吸数据集上进行的实验表明，TF-IG 的平均绝对误差 (MAE) 为 1.227 BPM，均方根误差 (RMSE) 为 2.060 BPM，Pearson 相关系数为 0.9934，3 BPM 内的估计率为 92.28%，同时保持参数效率，仅为 84.6K参数。消融结果进一步证明了时间和频率分支、交互门控融合和共享回归头的互补贡献。这些结果表明，显式建模跨域交互为基于 PPG 的轻量级 HR 估计提供了有效的准确性与复杂性权衡。

items.title: Reinforcement learning for hardware acceleration and system-level optimization on FPGA and integrated-circuit platforms: A survey
items.titleZh: FPGA 和集成电路平台上硬件加速和系统级优化的强化学习：一项调查
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28699v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables adaptive and autonomous decision-making in embedded, edge, and heterogeneous computing systems. Field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and integrated circuits (ICs) offer low latency, energy efficiency, and architectural flexibility for RL deployment, while introducing challenges in resource constraints, implementation complexity, and hardware-algorithm co-design. This review surveys more than 100 studies on RL implementations across FPGA and IC platforms, emphasizing architectures, implementation strategies, performance evaluation, and applications. The literature is organized by RL family, including model-based Markov decision processes, classical value-based methods, deep RL, actor-critic, policy-gradient, and multi-agent approaches. We further classify studies by abstraction level, hardware realization strategy, and application domain, examining how RL algorithms map onto reconfigurable and fixed hardware. Unlike surveys restricted to particular algorithms or platforms, this work provides a unified analysis of FPGA and IC implementations, covering acceleration, reconfigurable architectures, energy-aware control, and system-level optimization. Comparative assessments consider resource utilization, latency, throughput, power consumption, and reported performance gains. Finally, we identify recurring architectural patterns, practical limitations, open challenges, and research directions for efficient RL-driven hardware systems. The survey offers a consolidated reference for researchers developing and evaluating RL solutions on specialized hardware.

arXiv:2610.28699v1 公告类型：新
摘要：强化学习（RL）可以在嵌入式、边缘和异构计算系统中实现自适应和自主决策。现场可编程门阵列 (FPGA) 和集成电路 (IC) 为 RL 部署提供低延迟、高能效和架构灵活性，同时带来了资源限制、实现复杂性和硬件算法协同设计方面的挑战。本综述调查了 100 多项跨 FPGA 和 IC 平台的 RL 实现研究，重点关注架构、实现策略、性能评估和应用。文献按 RL 系列进行组织，包括基于模型的马尔可夫决策过程、基于经典价值的方法、深度 RL、演员批评家、策略梯度和多智能体方法。我们进一步按照抽象层次、硬件实现策略和应用领域对研究进行分类，研究强化学习算法如何映射到可重构和固定硬件上。与仅限于特定算法或平台的调查不同，这项工作提供了 FPGA 和 IC 实现的统一分析，涵盖加速、可重构架构、能源感知控制和系统级优化。比较评估考虑资源利用率、延迟、吞吐量、功耗和报告的性能增益。最后，我们确定了高效 RL 驱动的硬件系统的反复出现的架构模式、实际限制、开放挑战和研究方向。该调查为研究人员在专用硬件上开发和评估 RL 解决方案提供了综合参考。

items.title: Scalable Stress-Constrained Topology Optimization: A Super-resolution and Simultaneous Approach Based on Machine Learning
items.titleZh: 可扩展的应力约束拓扑优化：基于机器学习的超分辨率同步方法
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28703v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large-scale topology optimization (TO) remains computationally demanding, especially for stress-constrained problems. To address this challenge, we propose the simultaneous neural topology optimization (SNTO) framework where we represent state, adjoint, and design variables with custom neural networks (NNs) whose parameters are jointly optimized within a single optimization loop that leverages continuous adjoint analysis and automatic differentiation. This optimization minimizes a multi-component loss function that combines the design objective, an aggregation of the local stress constraints, and the potential energy functionals. Our NNs have a unique architecture that accelerates convergence while enabling the networks to capture sharp gradients and boundaries which are critical to stress-constrained TO. To achieve scalability to millions of degrees of freedom (DoF), we develop a hardware-aware training scheme in which the design domain is partitioned into subdomains that are distributed across multiple GPUs. To control peak GPU memory usage, we further slice each subdomain into smaller regions whose loss gradients are evaluated sequentially and accumulated to update the NN parameters. Unlike domain decomposition approaches, our partitioning naturally ensures field continuity across the subdomains and does not require the introduction of additional terms into the loss function. For validation, we first evaluate the proposed framework on various 2D stress-constrained benchmarks and compare our results to a conventional finite element-based approach, showing that SNTO produces super-resolution designs with sharper boundaries, smaller gray areas, and lower volume fractions. We then consider large-scale 3D problems with up to eight million collocation points and distribute the training over up to eight GPUs.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.28703v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大规模拓扑优化（TO）仍然对计算要求很高，特别是对于应力约束问题。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了同步神经拓扑优化（SNTO）框架，其中我们使用自定义神经网络（NN）表示状态、伴随和设计变量，其参数在利用连续伴随分析和自动微分的单个优化循环内联合优化。这种优化最大限度地减少了多分量损失函数，该函数结合了设计目标、​​局部应力约束的聚合和势能泛函。我们的神经网络拥有独特的架构，可以加速收敛，同时使网络能够捕获对于应力约束 TO 至关重要的尖锐梯度和边界。为了实现数百万自由度 (DoF) 的可扩展性，我们开发了一种硬件感知训练方案，其中设计域被划分为分布在多个 GPU 上的子域。为了控制 GPU 内存使用峰值，我们进一步将每个子域分割成更小的区域，按顺序评估其损失梯度并累积以更新神经网络参数。与域分解方法不同，我们的划分自然地确保了子域之间的场连续性，并且不需要在损失函数中引入附加项。为了进行验证，我们首先在各种 2D 应力约束基准上评估所提出的框架，并将我们的结果与传统的基于有限元的方法进行比较，表明 SNTO 产生的超分辨率设计具有更清晰的边界、更小的灰色区域和更低的体积分数。然后，我们考虑具有多达 800 万个配置点的大规模 3D 问题，并将训练分布在多达 8 个 GPU 上。

items.title: SimHack: Predicting the onset of detectable reward hacking before RL training
items.titleZh: SimHack：在 RL 训练之前预测可检测的奖励黑客行为的发生
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28707v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: When training LLMs to code with reinforcement learning, reward hacking is often detectable but difficult to prevent, since (a) environment hardening is increasingly difficult as training environments grow more complex; and (b) training-time interventions incentivize models to obfuscate hacking behavior to bypass detection.
 We instead study whether we can predict when detectable reward hacking becomes dominant before executing an RL run, enabling us to select lower-risk recipes in advance. We find that the initial hacking rate alone does not determine onset, which varies substantially across training recipes and repeated runs. We thus formulate this problem as predicting the distribution of the reward hacking onset step under a target training recipe.
 We introduce SimHack, a simulator that learns reward hacking training dynamics from a handful of smaller-scale reference RL runs and generates counterfactual simulation runs of unseen target recipes without costly retraining. Across unseen target recipes, SimHack predicts the median onset to a relative error of 11.3% and achieves across-recipe rank correlation of 0.85, while generalizing to differences in model scale, curriculum, number of rollouts, and learning rate between reference and target recipes. As an application, we show that SimHack can guide training decisions by screening candidate RL curricula, discovering curricula over the same set of scenarios that train for 96.6% longer without hacking.

摘要：当训练法学硕士使用强化学习进行编码时，奖励黑客行为通常是可以检测到的，但很难预防，因为（a）随着训练环境变得越来越复杂，环境强化变得越来越困难； (b) 训练时干预激励模型混淆黑客行为以绕过检测。

items.title: STAR-XPC: Set Transformer for Estimating X-ray Transmission in Polymer Composites
items.titleZh: STAR-XPC：用于估计聚合物复合材料中 X 射线透射的设置变压器
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28709v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Evaluating the energy transmission ratio of an X-ray beam through a polymer composite is a challenging task in radiation shielding studies. The reference solution with Monte Carlo transport simulation is highly accurate but computationally expensive: each of our reference simulations is capped at $4\times10^9$ photon histories and a 20,000 s (over 5 hours) time limit, while closed-form analytical methods fail to represent such complex scenarios. We present an artificial neural network model that maps the unordered multi-set of molecular constituents, their mass fractions, and four bulk physical descriptors directly to the transmission ratio $I(t)/I_0$ in 1-3 milliseconds. The model is a Set Transformer, which makes it permutation invariant by construction and accepts mixtures of different sizes up to 11 constituents within a fixed-size padded set. Each constituent is embedded with a chemistry-pretrained transformer language model, ChemBERTa. In our proposed method, training data are produced by an automated PENELOPE/penEasy pipeline using the radiation source at 30, 80, 100, and 120 kV tube voltages over polyethylene-based shielding composite slabs of thicknesses spanning 0.15-2.5 mm. After preprocessing, the dataset contains $n = 4697$ simulated configurations on which a leakage-free, jointly stratified 10-fold cross-validation is performed, attaining mean squared error MSE = $(1.12 \pm 0.56)\times10^{-4}$, normalized-MSE percentage NMSE% = 0.0294% $\pm$ 0.0147%, and $R^2 = 0.9988$. The corresponding per-sample percentage errors give an alpha-trimmed ($\alpha = 0.10$) absolute percentage error (APE) of 1.66% and a median APE of 1.15%. Our model's inference is several orders of magnitude faster than the underlying Monte Carlo simulation (sub-millisecond per query vs. several hours for the reference run) with effective accuracy in predicting $I(t)/I_0$.

items.title: Big Claims, Small Margins: Do Reported GraphLLM Gains Survive Simple Baselines?
items.titleZh: 大索赔，小利润：报告的 GraphLLM 收益是否能够维持简单的基线？
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28714v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: LLM-based methods for node classification on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) routinely report state-of-the-art accuracy. We ask how these results compare with inexpensive baselines run on the same splits. On the splits of three recent studies, we tune four baseline representatives with validation-only selection and compare them with the highest mean that each paper reports for an LLM-based method in the matched setting. Correct & Smooth on TF-IDF features trails this reference by a median of 2.3 percentage points, and an MLP on frozen e5-large-v2 embeddings by 2.8 points. Correct & Smooth is within 3 points of the reference or better on 15 of 24 tasks, but the reference is significantly higher on 12 of 22 testable tasks, so several reported gains remain substantial. Reading released code next to the papers, we also document evaluation risks: selection of hyperparameters or checkpoints on the test set, labels of test-pool nodes used in training, baseline numbers reused without disclosure, and a text-label misalignment in a released Cora loader. Reports of the same method on the same split also differ by up to 12.5 points across papers whose configurations are not documented to match.

摘要：基于 LLM 的文本属性图（TAG）节点分类方法通常会报告最先进的准确性。我们询问这些结果与在相同分组上运行的廉价基线相比如何。在最近三项研究的分裂中，我们通过仅验证选择调整了四个基线代表，并将它们与每篇论文在匹配设置中报告的基于 LLM 的方法的最高平均值进行比较。 TF-IDF 特征上的 Correct & Smooth 比参考文献落后了中值 2.3 个百分点，而冻结 e5-large-v2 嵌入上的 MLP 落后了 2.8 个百分点。在 24 项任务中，有 15 项任务的“正确与平滑”与参考值的差距在 3 分之内或更好，但在 22 项可测试任务中，有 12 项的参考值明显更高，因此一些报告的收益仍然很大。阅读论文旁边发布的代码，我们还记录了评估风险：测试集上超参数或检查点的选择、训练中使用的测试池节点的标签、在未披露的情况下重用的基线数字，以及已发布的 Cora 加载程序中的文本标签未对齐。在配置未记录匹配的论文中，同一分割的相同方法的报告也存在高达 12.5 分的差异。

items.title: Offline Apprenticeship Learning for Human-Centric Environments
items.titleZh: 以人为本的环境下的线下学徒学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28716v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Effective decision-making in human-centric environments such as Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITSs) and clinical healthcare requires policies that are adaptive, data-efficient, and ethically deployable. Apprenticeship Learning (AL) infers policies directly from expert demonstrations by recovering the underlying reward structure, enabling strictly offline learning without environment interaction. This dissertation develops a progression of offline AL frameworks organized around two challenges: reward modeling and demonstration quality. For reward modeling, EM-EDM clusters demonstrations by latent reward functions and induces cluster-specific policies, and THEMES partitions trajectories into temporally coherent sub-trajectories guided by a hierarchically learned reward regulator; across one educational and three clinical datasets, THEMES outperforms flat and hierarchical AL baselines. For demonstration quality, HALIDE integrates continuous quality signals into hierarchical policy induction, enabling principled reuse of mixed-quality data under distribution shift. CCHAL further attributes quality to individual decisions via Bayesian credit assignment, dual-arm criticality scoring that contrasts expert and non-expert behavior, and a Bradley-Terry contrastive IRL objective over failure trajectories, outperforming baselines including HALIDE on three clinical EHR datasets and an ITS dataset. Finally, a real-world classroom evaluation of StuEDM, an EDM-induced policy that preserves student agency and intervenes only on disagreement, shows significant learning gains over an Expert baseline and a higher pretest-adjusted posttest score than a CQL policy trained on a far larger corpus, while overriding students less than half as often. Together, this work establishes offline AL as a practical, data-efficient, and ethically viable paradigm for human-centric environments.

arXiv:2610.28716v1 公告类型：新
摘要：在以人为中心的环境（例如智能辅导系统（ITS）和临床医疗保健）中进行有效的决策需要具有适应性、数据效率高且可道德部署的政策。学徒学习（AL）通过恢复底层奖励结构，直接从专家演示中推断出策略，从而实现严格的离线学习，无需环境交互。本论文围绕两个挑战开发了一系列离线 AL 框架：奖励建模和演示质量。对于奖励建模，EM-EDM 通过潜在奖励函数对演示进行聚类，并引入特定于集群的策略，而 THEMES 将轨迹划分为由分层学习的奖励调节器引导的时间连贯的子轨迹；在一个教育数据集和三个临床数据集上，THEMES 的表现优于平面和分层的 AL 基线。为了演示质量，HALIDE 将连续的质量信号集成到分层策略归纳中，从而能够在分布转移下原则性地重用混合质量数据。 CCHAL 通过贝叶斯信用分配、对比专家和非专家行为的双臂关键性评分以及针对故障轨迹的 Bradley-Terry 对比 IRL 目标，进一步将质量归因于个人决策，在三个临床 EHR 数据集和一个 ITS 数据集上优于包括 HALIDE 在内的基线。最后，对 StuEDM（一种由 EDM 引发的政策，保留学生能动性并仅在出现分歧时进行干预）的现实世界课堂评估显示，与在更大的语料库上训练的 CQL 政策相比，与 Expert 基线相比有显着的学习收益，并且经前测调整的后测得分更高，而推翻学生的频率不到一半。总之，这项工作将离线 AL 建立为以人为中心的环境中实用、数据高效且道德上可行的范例。

items.title: ReAPO: Retry-Aware Policy Optimization for Efficient Exploration in LLM Reasoning
items.titleZh: ReAPO：重试感知策略优化，用于 LLM 推理中的高效探索
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28770v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: RLVR improves language-model reasoning, but commonly relies on independent stochastic rollouts for exploration, which can repeatedly sample similar failed strategies. Prior work has seen success with approaches that guide exploration by introducing dependence into the sampling process by including incorrect solutions in the context for subsequent attempts. Still, these methods introduce the additional question of how to assign credit to each attempt. We propose to view the credit assignment through the lens of Stochastic Shortest Paths, a framework in classical reinforcement learning that seeks to minimize the expected cumulative cost to reach a terminal state (in our case, a verified successful response). We show that, under suitable simplifying assumptions, this perspective naturally leads to a simple modification to GRPO, which we call Retry-Aware Policy Optimization (ReAPO). ReAPO allocates additional generation to failed trajectories, allowing successful retries to be reinforced without rewarding preceding failures, and assigns credit in a theoretically principled way to each attempt. Across Qwen3 and OLMo-2 models from 0.6B to 4B and eight mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks, ReAPO improves first-attempt performance over GRPO as well as natural recent baseline algorithms, while additional ablations demonstrate the utility of both serial sampling and ReAPO's credit assignment. On Qwen3-0.6B, ReAPO also outperforms GRPO with twice the group size or twice the training steps, reaching their peak accuracy with 39% and 31% fewer generated tokens, respectively. Taken together, our results suggest that ReAPO is a simple yet effective approach for improving LM reasoning performance through improved exploration and retry-aware credit assignment.

arXiv:2610.28770v1 公告类型：新
摘要：RLVR 改进了语言模型推理，但通常依赖于独立随机推出进行探索，它可以重复采样类似的失败策略。先前的工作已经取得了成功，通过在后续尝试的上下文中包含不正确的解决方案，将依赖性引入采样过程来指导探索。尽管如此，这些方法还是引入了额外的问题，即如何为每次尝试分配信用。我们建议通过随机最短路径的视角来看待信用分配，这是经典强化学习中的一个框架，旨在最小化达到最终状态的预期累积成本（在我们的例子中，是经过验证的成功响应）。我们表明，在适当的简化假设下，这种观点自然会导致对 GRPO 的简单修改，我们称之为重试感知策略优化（ReAPO）。 ReAPO 为失败的轨迹分配额外的生成，允许在不奖励先前失败的情况下强化成功的重试，并以理论上有原则的方式为每次尝试分配信用。在从 0.6B 到 4B 的 Qwen3 和 OLMo-2 模型以及八个数学和科学推理基准中，ReAPO 比 GRPO 以及自然的最近基线算法提高了首次尝试性能，而额外的消融则证明了串行采样和 ReAPO 信用分配的实用性。在 Qwen3-0.6B 上，ReAPO 的组大小或训练步数是 GRPO 的两倍，其性能也优于 GRPO，在生成的标记分别减少 39% 和 31% 的情况下达到了最高准确度。总而言之，我们的结果表明 ReAPO 是一种简单而有效的方法，可通过改进探索和重试感知信用分配来提高 LM 推理性能。

items.title: Motion Equivariant Convolutional LSTM: When Motion Becomes a Gauge Symmetry
items.titleZh: 运动等变卷积 LSTM：当运动成为规范对称时
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28771v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Objects move, cameras pan, and weather drifts with the wind: much of what changes in sequential data is motion. Motion changes where things are, not what they are, and is therefore a symmetry of the data. Yet standard recurrent networks are not equivariant to it: their memory stays put while the input moves on. Flow equivariant recurrent networks first brought this symmetry into sequence models, for motions of constant velocity, or flows, by enumerating a bank of velocities. We extend this idea in three directions: from simple recurrent networks to convolutional LSTMs, from flows to motions whose velocity changes in time, and from enumerating velocities to estimating them. Treating a sequence as a field over time, we show that motion becomes a gauge symmetry: a global symmetry made local in time. Built on this view, our motion equivariant convolutional LSTM (MELSTM) uses its velocity model as the gauge field and is provably equivariant to every motion. Across future-frame prediction, classification of digits visible only through their motion, and action recognition under camera shake, MELSTM outperforms a convolutional LSTM and its flow equivariant counterpart with the same number of parameters: it is more accurate, generalizes to longer horizons and to unseen motions, and carries a fraction of the flow equivariant model's state.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.28771v1 公告类型：新
摘要：物体移动、摄像机平移、天气随风飘移：序列数据的大部分变化都是运动。运动改变事物所在的位置，而不是事物本身，因此是数据的对称性。然而，标准的循环网络并不等同于它：当输入继续移动时，它们的记忆保持不变。流等变循环网络首先通过枚举一组速度将这种对称性引入序列模型，用于恒速运动或流。我们将这个想法扩展到三个方向：从简单的循环网络到卷积 LSTM，从流到速度随时间变化的运动，从枚举速度到估计速度。将序列视为随时间推移的场，我们表明运动成为规范对称性：时间上局部的全局对称性。基于这个观点，我们的运动等变卷积 LSTM (MELSTM) 使用其速度模型作为规范场，并且可证明对每个运动都是等变的。在未来帧预测、仅通过运动可见的数字分类以及相机抖动下的动作识别方面，MELSTM 优于卷积 LSTM 及其具有相同数量参数的流等变对应物：它更准确，可推广到更长的视野和看不见的运动，并且携带流等变模型状态的一小部分。

items.title: Building a Nested LADDER for LLM Unstructured Post-Training Pruning
items.titleZh: 为 LLM 非结构化训练后修剪构建嵌套 LADDER
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28773v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Non-uniform allocation can improve post-training pruning of large language models, yet quality can still degrade sharply at high sparsity. To control degradation as sparsity increases, we introduce LADDER (Layer-Wise Allocation via Damage-Driven Evaluation and Refinement), which allocates sparsity incrementally. At each step, it evaluates pruning an additional fraction of weights from each eligible layer and commits the layer update that causes the least end-to-end degradation per removed parameter. This process produces non-uniform sparsity profiles and exactly nested masks across multiple budgets. We evaluate LADDER on five OPT, Llama, and Qwen models across 10-90% sparsity, using SparseGPT as its candidate-generation backend and comparing against uniform and adaptive allocation baselines. Results reveal a clear operating-regime trade-off: LADDER is comparable or slightly weaker at benign sparsity but becomes substantially more robust from 70% onward. This high-sparsity advantage largely persists after posterior distillation across four of five models and translates into improved retention of aggregate zero-shot accuracy.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.28773v1 公告类型：新
摘要：非均匀分配可以改善大型语言模型的训练后剪枝，但在高稀疏性下质量仍然会急剧下降。为了控制稀疏性增加时的退化，我们引入了 LADDER（通过损伤驱动评估和细化进行分层分配），它增量分配稀疏性。在每个步骤中，它都会评估从每个符合条件的层中修剪额外的权重分数，并提交导致每个删除的参数的端到端降级最少的层更新。此过程会在多个预算中产生不均匀的稀疏度分布和精确嵌套的掩模。我们使用 SparseGPT 作为候选生成后端，在 10-90% 稀疏度的 5 个 OPT、Llama 和 Qwen 模型上评估 LADDER，并与统一和自适应分配基线进行比较。结果揭示了明显的操作机制权衡：LADDER 在良性稀疏性下相当或稍弱，但从 70% 开始变得更加稳健。这种高稀疏性优势在对五个模型中的四个进行后级蒸馏后基本上仍然存在，并转化为提高了总体零样本精度的保留率。

items.title: Second Thoughts: Exploring and Planning through Comparative Imagination in World Models
items.titleZh: 第二思考：通过世界模型中的比较想象进行探索和规划
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28779v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: World models let agents compare imagined outcomes before acting, but an agent must still decide which alternatives to explore and when a proposed plan should replace its learned policy. We introduce SDI (Sibling Disagreement in Imagination), which connects these decisions through a shared actor-based reference. SDI compares action sequences imagined from the same model state, using repeated rollouts of the actor's own sequence to measure variation under fixed behavior. This reference scales both the spread across candidate returns, which provides an exploration signal, and a proposed plan's predicted advantage, which governs action acceptance. The agent executes a planned action when its advantage exceeds the reference variability by a fixed factor; otherwise, it follows the actor. SDI reuses the base agent's world model, actor, and critic without requiring an additional disagreement ensemble. Exploration and planning guide training data collection, while evaluation uses the learned actor alone. Across Meta-World, Adroit, and DM-Control, SDI achieves a higher observed task-average score than every compared baseline in each suite and matches or exceeds the strongest baseline's performance on 15 of 18 tasks. Component ablations and robustness analyses further examine the roles of exploration, planning exposure, and action acceptance. Paired evaluations from identical simulator states show that the gate improves both recovery from actor failures and preservation of successful behavior relative to ungated planning, while substantially reducing return degradation. Together, these results support comparing imagined alternatives against a shared actor reference as a unified approach to exploring and planning with world models.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.28779v1 公告类型：新
摘要：世界模型让智能体在行动之前比较想象的结果，但智能体仍然必须决定探索哪些替代方案以及何时提出的计划应该取代其学到的策略。我们引入了 SDI（兄弟姐妹想象力分歧），它通过基于共享参与者的参考来连接这些决策。 SDI 比较从相同模型状态想象的动作序列，使用演员自己的序列的重复推出来测量固定行为下的变化。该参考缩放了候选回报之间的分布（提供探索信号）和拟议计划的预测优势（控制行动接受度）。当代理的优势超过参考可变性固定因子时，代理将执行计划的操作；否则，它会跟随演员。 SDI 重用了基础代理的世界模型、参与者和评论家，而不需要额外的分歧集合。探索和规划指导训练数据收集，而评估则仅使用学习到的参与者。在 Meta-World、Adroit 和 DM-Control 中，SDI 实现了比每个套件中的每个比较基线更高的观察到的任务平均得分，并且在 18 项任务中的 15 项上匹配或超过了最强基线的性能。组件消融和稳健性分析进一步检验了探索、规划暴露和行动接受的作用。来自相同模拟器状态的配对评估表明，与非门控规划相比，门可以改善参与者故障的恢复和成功行为的保留，同时大大减少返回退化。总之，这些结果支持将想象的替代方案与共享参与者参考进行比较，作为利用世界模型进行探索和规划的统一方法。

items.title: Extreme Low-State Quantized Transformer for Electricity-Load Forecasting
items.titleZh: 用于电力负荷预测的极低状态量化变压器
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28784v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Aggressive low-state weight quantization can substantially reduce neural-network representational flexibility, making predictive performance difficult to preserve when only a few discrete weight states are available. We investigate this regime for Transformer-based electricity-load forecasting using 3-, 5-, 7-, and 16-state weight quantization across feed-forward-only and attention-plus-feed-forward quantization. Two tasks predict either the next hour or the next 24 hours from the preceding 48 hours across two co-primary electricity-consumption datasets. Direct post-training quantization (PTQ) increased mean normalized root-mean-square error (NRMSE) relative to full precision by 6.25 and 7.04 percentage points in Datasets A and B, whereas quantization-aware fine-tuning (QAT-FT) recovered approximately 90.2% and 94.5% of these penalties. Quantization-aware training from random initialization (Scratch-QAT) also produced competitive low-state solutions, with particularly favorable behavior at three states. We further introduce accumulated-update thresholding, which accumulates optimizer-proposed weight changes before commitment. Relative to paired Scratch-QAT controls, this reduced committed shadow-weight updates by approximately 99.7% and discrete state transitions by approximately 77--80%, while mean NRMSE changed by only +0.042 and +0.197 percentage points. These results show that useful Transformer forecasting can be retained under highly discrete weight representations while strongly suppressing target-state activity, supporting a prospective route toward compact, low-activity edge forecasting using multilevel synaptic devices.

arXiv:2610.28784v1 公告类型：新
摘要：激进的低状态权重量化会大大降低神经网络表示的灵活性，使得当只有少数离散权重状态可用时，预测性能难以保持。我们使用 3、5、7 和 16 状态权重量化（仅前馈量化和注意力加前馈量化）来研究这种基于 Transformer 的电力负荷预测机制。两项任务根据两个共同主要用电量数据集预测前 48 小时内的下一小时或未来 24 小时。在数据集 A 和 B 中，直接训练后量化 (PTQ) 相对于完全精度将平均归一化均方根误差 (NRMSE) 提高了 6.25 和 7.04 个百分点，而量化感知微调 (QAT-FT) 则恢复了这些损失的约 90.2% 和 94.5%。来自随机初始化的量化感知训练（Scratch-QAT）也产生了有竞争力的低状态解决方案，在三种状态下具有特别有利的行为。我们进一步引入累积更新阈值，它在承诺之前累积优化器建议的权重变化。相对于成对的 Scratch-QAT 控制，这将提交的影子权重更新减少了大约 99.7%，离散状态转换减少了大约 77--80%，而平均 NRMSE 仅改变了 +0.042 和 +0.197 个百分点。这些结果表明，有用的 Transformer 预测可以在高度离散的权重表示下保留，同时强烈抑制目标状态活动，支持使用多级突触设备进行紧凑、低活动边缘预测的前瞻性路线。

items.title: Measure First, Then Allocate: Calibrated Rollout Budgets for MCP Agents in Reinforcement Learning
items.titleZh: 先测量，后分配：强化学习中 MCP 代理的校准部署预算
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28785v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Training tool-using language models requires costly interaction, yet identical rewards within a rollout group provide no group-relative learning signal. We use reward disagreement to guide harness evaluation and the allocation of rollouts for policy training in Model Context Protocol (MCP) environments. We first introduce Discord, which tests harness edits using exact paired inference and decision-preserving early stopping: only disagreeing paired outcomes favor one harness over another. This insight motivates prospective allocation in BRACE (Bank-calibrated Rollout Allocation under Correlated Episodes). BRACE combines historical task evidence, uncertainty in task success rates, and a correlated reward model to forecast mixed-reward groups before allocating generation budget. Controlled harness experiments favor Discord, while live MCP experiments expose a retention-cost trade-off. At three Qwen3-VL model scales, BRACE exceeds the strongest plotted baseline peaks with fewer new training rollouts; historical-bank collection is counted separately. It also leads the compared methods on BFCL and NESTFUL without further training. Ablations probe the bank, estimator, and allocation score; prospective evaluation checks forecast calibration. These results support forecasting reward contrast before generation.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.28785v1 公告类型：新
摘要：使用语言模型训练工具需要昂贵的交互，但推出组内相同的奖励不会提供与组相关的学习信号。我们使用奖励分歧来指导模型上下文协议（MCP）环境中策略培训的评估和部署分配。我们首先介绍 Discord，它使用精确配对推理和决策保留早期停止来测试工具编辑：只有不一致的配对结果才会有利于一种工具而不是另一种工具。这一见解激发了 BRACE（相关事件下银行校准的推出分配）的前瞻性分配。 BRACE 结合了历史任务证据、任务成功率的不确定性和相关奖励模型，在分配发电预算之前预测混合奖励组。受控的利用实验有利于 Discord，而实时 MCP 实验则暴露了保留成本的权衡。在三个 Qwen3-VL 模型尺度上，BRACE 超过了最强的绘制基线峰值，并且新的训练部署较少；历史银行收款是单独计算的。它还领先于 BFCL 和 NESTFUL 上的比较方法，无需进一步训练。消融探测银行、估算器和分配分数；前瞻性评估检查预测校准。这些结果支持在生成之前预测奖励对比。

items.title: ArcFlow: Training Flow Policies for Multiple Solver Budgets
items.titleZh: ArcFlow：多个求解器预算的训练流程策略
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.28788v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Flow-matching policies adjust inference cost through the number of solver steps, but reinforcement learning at a single fixed solver budget can hide degradation at cheaper deployment budgets and even erase useful one-step behavior present in a pretrained policy. We introduce Action-Ratio-Clip Flow (ArcFlow), a deployment-aware algorithm for training one flow policy across a specified range of solver budgets. ArcFlow combines action-aligned supervision, budget exposure, and worst-budget checkpoint selection. For reconstruction objectives, its bridge aggregates temporal probes into one surrogate ratio and one PPO-style clip per action, with a boundary residual exactly equal to deployed one-step reconstruction error. Cycling exposes the shared field to the deployment range, and selection optimizes its performance floor. For native velocity objectives, multi-budget endpoint supervision applies the same principle without replacing the native update. Both realizations preserve the architecture and deployment-time cost. Across DM Control, manipulation, and locomotion, ArcFlow attains the highest mean one-step return among five flow-policy baselines on 25 of 30 tasks under each method's reported training settings. Component studies identify complementary improvements from boundary supervision, the fixed-grid bridge, budget exposure, and deployment selection. These results establish deployment-budget-aware training as an effective route to strong low-step control with one policy serving multiple inference costs.

arXiv:2610.28788v1 公告类型：新
摘要：流匹配策略通过求解器步骤的数量来调整推理成本，但是单个固定求解器预算的强化学习可以隐藏更便宜的部署预算中的退化，甚至消除预训练策略中存在的有用的单步行为。我们引入了 Action-Ratio-Clip Flow (ArcFlow)，这是一种部署感知算法，用于在指定的求解器预算范围内训练一个流策略。 ArcFlow 结合了行动一致的监督、预算暴露和最差预算检查点选择。对于重建目标，它的桥将时间探针聚合为一个代理比率和每个动作一个 PPO 式剪辑，边界残差完全等于部署的一步重建误差。循环将共享区域暴露在部署范围内，而选择则优化其性能底线。对于本机速度目标，多预算端点监督应用相同的原则，而不替换本机更新。两种实现都保留了架构和部署时间成本。在 DM 控制、操作和运动方面，ArcFlow 在每种方法报告的训练设置下的 30 项任务中的 25 项中，在 5 个流策略基线中获得了最高的平均一步回报。组件研究确定了边界监督、固定电网桥梁、预算暴露和部署选择的补充改进。这些结果将部署预算感知训练确立为一种有效的途径，通过一个策略服务多个推理成本，实现强大的低步控制。
